title.zh: 雅柳嘉 · 驻唱支援与落霜循环
title.en: Miyabi / Yanagi / Astra · assist and Fallen Frost loop

summary.zh: 先建立驻唱，再靠实际支援入场吃加攻；柳对异常目标结算，雅满六再三蓄。
summary.en: Establish Cadenza, earn ATK through actual assist entries, resolve Yanagi’s hits against Anomalies, then spend six Fallen Frost.

conditions.zh: 按嘉音→雅→柳循环站位；本教学以雅主攻、0影无专武为基础。
conditions.en: Use the cyclic order Astra→Miyabi→Yanagi. This guide focuses on Miyabi and starts from M0 without signatures.

conditions.zh: 作者资料为1.5，技能按固定3.3核对；没有固定秒轴或最高分保证。
conditions.en: The tutorial dates to 1.5 and is checked against fixed 3.3 skills; no fixed timing or maximum-score claim.

conditions.zh: 咏叹华彩仍在不等于每人加攻已刷新；和弦、消耗能量及对应入场分别检查。
conditions.en: Active Cadenza does not mean every ally’s ATK buff refreshed; check Chords, energy spending and each entry separately.

label.zh: 小橙子 · 耀嘉音操作与雅柳队（1.5）
label.en: Orange · Astra mechanics and Miyabi/Yanagi team (1.5)

label.zh: 小橙子 · 柳操作与火电队（1.3）
label.en: Orange · Yanagi mechanics and Fire/Electric team (1.3)

label.zh: 耀嘉音 · 固定 Gachabase 3.3
label.en: Astra Yao · fixed Gachabase 3.3

label.zh: 雅 · 固定 Gachabase 3.3
label.en: Miyabi · fixed Gachabase 3.3

label.zh: 柳 · 固定 Gachabase 3.3
label.en: Yanagi · fixed Gachabase 3.3

label.zh: 开局
label.en: Opening

objective.zh: 建立驻唱与雅柳的支援接力。
objective.en: Establish Cadenza and the Miyabi/Yanagi assist handoff.

title.zh: 嘉音开启驻唱，按提示接雅
title.en: Astra starts singing; take Miyabi’s prompt

input.zh: 点按特殊技，命中后按雅的快速支援提示。
input.en: Tap Special, then respond to Miyabi’s Quick Assist prompt after a hit.

trigger.zh: 咏叹华彩未建立或需要重新准备雅的增益；普通特殊技本身不要求25能量。
trigger.en: Idyllic Cadenza is absent or Miyabi needs support setup. The normal Special itself does not require 25 energy.

complete.zh: 确认进入咏叹华彩且命中出现提示；加攻还要下一步支援入场时实际消耗嘉音能量。
complete.en: Confirm Cadenza and an actual hit-generated prompt. The ATK buff also requires Astra to spend energy on the assist entry.

reason.zh: 作者以嘉音→雅→柳站位提供互切；驻唱通用增益和消耗能量的加攻不能混为一项。
reason.en: The author uses Astra→Miyabi→Yanagi for switches; Cadenza buffs and the energy-consuming ATK buff are separate.

fallback.zh: 未命中就重新找目标；没有快支提示时普通换人可以接战，但不能冒充本步快支加攻。
fallback.en: After a miss, reacquire the target. A normal switch can enter combat without a prompt, but does not replace this assist-triggered ATK buff.

signal.zh: 实际出现雅的快支提示时接手。
signal.en: Take Miyabi’s actual Quick Assist prompt.

title.en: Miyabi Quick Assist: verify the ATK buff

input.zh: 按嘉音触发的雅快支提示。
input.en: Respond to Miyabi’s Quick Assist prompt from Astra.

trigger.zh: 确有雅的快支提示；若已被嘉音Q替换为连携，改走爆发阶段的连携事件。
trigger.en: Miyabi’s actual prompt is available. If Astra’s Ultimate replaced it with a Chain, use the burst-phase Chain event.

complete.zh: 确认入场；嘉音实际消耗25能量追加震音，才确认本次加攻成立。
complete.en: Confirm entry. Count this ATK buff only if Astra actually spends 25 energy for Tremolo.

reason.zh: 及时响应可触发精准支援，但不能为追提示打断尚未兑现的关键伤害。
reason.en: A timely response can trigger Precise Assist; do not sacrifice an unresolved key hit just to chase a prompt.

fallback.zh: 没有提示则跳过；嘉音能量不足不补造加攻，先按实际状态输出或恢复资源。
fallback.en: Skip without a prompt. Insufficient Astra energy does not grant an assumed ATK buff; use the actual state or restore resources.

label.zh: 嘉音持续驻唱 · 咏叹华彩未退出
label.en: Astra keeps singing · while Idyllic Cadenza remains active

title.zh: 雅建立烈霜异常，再提示柳接手
title.en: Miyabi establishes Frost, then hands to Yanagi

input.zh: 以普攻后三段积累烈霜；看实际异常与落霜。
input.en: Build Frost through the later Basic hits; read the actual Anomaly and Fallen Frost.

trigger.zh: 目标尚需烈霜异常；嘉音咏叹华彩仍在。已满6落霜且需先兑现时跳至三蓄。
trigger.en: Frost still needs establishing and Astra is singing. If six Fallen Frost should be spent first, go to the charged slash.

complete.zh: 关键命中与烈霜异常实际成立后，只有柳的快支提示出现才交给柳。
complete.en: After the required hit and actual Frost Anomaly, hand to Yanagi only on her real Quick Assist prompt.

reason.zh: 柳极性紊乱需要异常目标；霜灼不是直接保证柳下落命中时仍有异常。
reason.en: Yanagi’s Polarity Disorder needs an Anomalous target; Frostburn alone is not a guarantee that an Anomaly remains at the downward hit.

fallback.zh: 没有和弦或提示时普通换柳并跳过快支事件；不把普通换人计为刷新嘉音加攻。
fallback.en: Without Chords or a prompt, switch normally to Yanagi and skip her Quick Assist event; this does not refresh Astra’s ATK buff.

label.zh: 嘉音持续驻唱 · 咏叹华彩未退出
label.en: Astra keeps singing · while Idyllic Cadenza remains active

signal.zh: 嘉音有和弦且命中触发柳的快支提示后接柳；无提示走普通换人分支。
signal.en: Take Yanagi only when Astra has Chords and a hit generates her Quick Assist prompt; otherwise use the normal-switch fallback.

title.en: Yanagi takes the actual Quick Assist

input.zh: 按柳的快速支援提示，接战后可衔接第三段普攻。
input.en: Respond to Yanagi’s Quick Assist; Basic can then begin from its third hit.

trigger.zh: 实际提示指向柳；不是已被嘉音Q替换的连携提示。
trigger.en: The actual prompt targets Yanagi and has not been replaced by an Astra Ultimate Chain.

complete.zh: 确认快支命中及入场，嘉音是否耗能加攻另外核对。
complete.en: Confirm assist entry and the hit; separately check whether Astra spent energy for the ATK buff.

reason.zh: 把快支动作单列，防止普通切人被误当成已获得增益。
reason.en: A separate assist event avoids counting a normal switch as buffed entry.

fallback.zh: 没有快支提示则跳过；通过普通换人入场后按实际资源继续。
fallback.en: Skip without a Quick Assist prompt; after a normal switch continue with the real resources.

label.zh: 嘉音持续驻唱 · 咏叹华彩未退出
label.en: Astra keeps singing · while Idyllic Cadenza remains active

title.zh: 异常目标上长按EX，确认极性紊乱
title.en: Hold EX against an Anomalous target

input.zh: 能量足够时长按强化特殊技，完成下落攻击。
input.en: With enough energy, hold EX Special and complete the downward attack.

trigger.zh: 下落攻击命中时目标确实处于属性异常；不是只看上一步曾经挂过。
trigger.en: The target must still be under an Attribute Anomaly when the downward attack hits.

complete.zh: 确认实际极性紊乱；如另触发普通紊乱再另计，不保证一次EX回4落霜。
complete.en: Confirm actual Polarity Disorder. Count a separate ordinary Disorder only if it occurs; one EX is not guaranteed to grant four Fallen Frost.

reason.zh: 极性紊乱不清除当前异常；普通紊乱及资源回点按真实结算判断。
reason.en: Polarity Disorder does not remove the current Anomaly; ordinary Disorder and resource gains follow actual results.

fallback.zh: 无异常先打积蓄；缺能量先用合法普攻和流转，不空按EX。
fallback.en: Without an Anomaly, build one first. Without energy, use valid Basics and stance switches.

label.zh: 嘉音持续驻唱 · 咏叹华彩未退出
label.en: Astra keeps singing · while Idyllic Cadenza remains active

prep.zh: 若已经有嘉音Q替换次数，不把连携提示当普通快支。
prep.en: If Astra’s Ultimate replacements are active, treat converted prompts as Chains, not ordinary Quick Assists.

label.zh: 常态循环
label.en: Regular loop

objective.zh: 先看异常与和弦，再让柳结算并交回满六的雅。
objective.en: Check Anomaly and Chords, let Yanagi resolve, then return to Miyabi with six.

title.en: Hold EX against an Anomalous target

label.zh: 嘉音持续驻唱 · 咏叹华彩未退出
label.en: Astra keeps singing · while Idyllic Cadenza remains active

title.zh: 柳衔接快速流转，再按落霜切雅
title.en: Yanagi cycles stances, then checks Miyabi’s resource

input.zh: 普攻第3、4或5段后点按特殊技，再接第三段普攻。
input.en: Tap Special after Basic 3, 4 or 5, then resume from Basic 3.

trigger.zh: 需要补电异常或维持架势；雅已经6落霜且增益齐时，跳过积攒仍先普通切雅，再执行下一步三蓄。
trigger.en: Build Electric Anomaly or maintain stances. If Miyabi already has six Fallen Frost and her buffs, skip buildup but still switch normally to her before the next charged slash.

complete.zh: 确认当前异常与实际落霜；完成当前关键攻击后普通切雅。
complete.en: Check the current Anomaly and Fallen Frost; after the current key attack, switch normally to Miyabi.

reason.zh: 切换架势可以保留前一架势效果；不以固定普攻次数保证感电或资源满。
reason.en: Stance switching retains the previous stance’s effect; fixed Basic counts do not guarantee Shock or full resources.

fallback.zh: 衔接失误回到可用普攻；雅加攻已过期则先回开局支援准备。
fallback.en: If the link fails, use available Basics. If Miyabi’s ATK buff expired, return to assist setup first.

label.zh: 嘉音持续驻唱 · 咏叹华彩未退出
label.en: Astra keeps singing · while Idyllic Cadenza remains active

signal.zh: 当前动作完成后普通切雅；本次不冒充快支刷新加攻。
signal.en: After the current action, switch normally to Miyabi; do not treat this as an ATK-refreshing Quick Assist.

title.zh: 实际6落霜，完成三段霜月
title.en: Spend six actual Fallen Frost on Shimotsuki

input.zh: 长按普攻至三段蓄力完成，再释放斩击。
input.en: Hold Basic through all three charging stages, then release the slash.

trigger.zh: 实际持有6落霜；目标可命中，雅需要的增益仍覆盖。
trigger.en: Six Fallen Frost are actually available, the target is hittable and Miyabi’s required buffs remain active.

complete.zh: 本方案前台完成关键斩击；核对实际命中，不假定提前切人仍能结算全部异常。
complete.en: This guide keeps Miyabi on field for the key slash. Confirm the hit rather than assuming an early switch preserves every Anomaly result.

reason.zh: 三段每段消耗2落霜；本轮没有原作者可核验的提前切出动画节点，保留稳定执行。
reason.en: Each stage costs two Fallen Frost. No independently verified early-switch animation cue is claimed in this guide.

fallback.zh: 不足6时用实际可用EX、终结技或队伍紊乱补足；不要把一二蓄当三蓄。
fallback.en: Below six, use actually available EX, Ultimate or squad Disorder; one or two stages are not a three-stage slash.

label.zh: 嘉音持续驻唱 · 咏叹华彩未退出
label.en: Astra keeps singing · while Idyllic Cadenza remains active

prep.zh: 雅加攻失效先回嘉音快支准备；没有提示就走普通换人，不虚构刷新。
prep.en: If Miyabi’s ATK buff expires, return to Astra’s assist setup. A normal switch without a prompt does not refresh it.

label.zh: 爆发窗口
label.en: Burst window

objective.zh: 嘉音Q可用时以两次真实连携衔接，再兑现落霜。
objective.en: When Astra’s Ultimate is ready, use its two actual Chains before spending Fallen Frost.

title.zh: 嘉音Q就绪时，把后两次快支转为连携
title.en: Astra’s ready Ultimate converts the next two assists

input.zh: 终结技，命中后按实际连携提示选择雅。
input.en: Use Ultimate; after a hit, take Miyabi’s actual converted Chain prompt.

trigger.zh: 嘉音自身终结技就绪，目标可命中；确认本轮需要治疗或连携接力。
trigger.en: Astra’s own Ultimate is ready and can hit; use when healing or converted Chains fit this window.

complete.zh: 进入咏叹华彩并取得两次替换；只有真实提示出现才执行后续连携。
complete.en: Enter Cadenza and gain two replacements; perform the following Chains only when their prompts actually appear.

reason.zh: 这是技能给予的连携，并不证明敌人已经失衡。
reason.en: These Chains come from Astra’s ability; they do not prove that the enemy is Stunned.

fallback.zh: 未就绪则跳过连携分支，沿开局快支和常态循环；不借用队友喧响。
fallback.en: If unavailable, skip this Chain branch and use the opening assist/regular loop; no teammate Decibels are borrowed.

signal.zh: 嘉音Q实际命中后，响应已替换的雅连携提示。
signal.en: After Astra’s Ultimate actually hits, respond to Miyabi’s converted Chain prompt.

title.zh: 雅连携接手，保留下一次提示
title.en: Miyabi takes the Chain and checks the next prompt

input.zh: 在实际连携提示中选择雅。
input.en: Select Miyabi on the actual Chain prompt.

trigger.zh: 嘉音Q替换次数仍在且提示可用；不要按普通快支招式处理。
trigger.en: An Astra Ultimate replacement remains and the prompt is available; this is not the normal Quick Assist move.

complete.zh: 关键命中完成；仍有替换次数且命中触发柳提示时再接下一步。
complete.en: Complete the key hit. Continue only if a replacement remains and the hit generates Yanagi’s prompt.

reason.zh: 嘉音Q次数耗尽前连携命中会继续触发提示；加攻仍需要实际耗能。
reason.en: Before the replacements are exhausted, Chain hits generate another prompt; the ATK buff still needs actual energy consumption.

fallback.zh: 没有下一次提示就结束连携分支，普通换柳按实际资源继续。
fallback.en: Without the next prompt, end the Chain branch and switch normally to Yanagi if appropriate.

label.zh: 嘉音持续驻唱 · 咏叹华彩未退出
label.en: Astra keeps singing · while Idyllic Cadenza remains active

signal.zh: 仅实际出现被替换的柳连携提示时接柳。
signal.en: Take Yanagi only on her actual converted Chain prompt.

title.zh: 柳连携换架势，核对目标异常
title.en: Yanagi’s Chain changes stance; inspect the target

input.zh: 在实际连携提示中选择柳。
input.en: Select Yanagi on the actual Chain prompt.

trigger.zh: 确有柳的连携提示；本次只消费实际剩余的一次替换。
trigger.en: Yanagi’s Chain prompt is present; spend only an actually remaining replacement.

complete.zh: 确认连携完成、架势变化与当前异常；没有异常不强接极性。
complete.en: Confirm the Chain, stance change and current Anomaly. Do not force Polarity without an Anomaly.

reason.zh: 柳连携本身不能被当作EX下落触发极性紊乱。
reason.en: Yanagi’s Chain is not an EX downward hit and is not itself a Polarity Disorder trigger.

fallback.zh: 缺提示跳过；需要异常时先用可用普攻衔接。
fallback.en: Skip without a prompt; use available Basics if an Anomaly needs building.

label.en: Astra keeps singing · while Idyllic Cadenza remains active

signal.zh: 下落结算完成后普通切雅；需要的增益先确认。
signal.en: After the downward hit resolves, switch normally to Miyabi with the required buffs confirmed.

title.zh: 实际6落霜，完成三段霜月
title.en: Spend six actual Fallen Frost on Shimotsuki

input.zh: 长按普攻至三段蓄力完成，再释放斩击。
input.en: Hold Basic through all three charging stages, then release the slash.

trigger.zh: 实际持有6落霜；目标可命中，雅需要的增益仍覆盖。
trigger.en: Six Fallen Frost are actually available, the target is hittable and Miyabi’s required buffs remain active.

complete.zh: 本方案前台完成关键斩击；核对实际命中，不假定提前切人仍能结算全部异常。
complete.en: This guide keeps Miyabi on field for the key slash. Confirm the hit rather than assuming an early switch preserves every Anomaly result.

reason.zh: 三段每段消耗2落霜；本轮没有原作者可核验的提前切出动画节点，保留稳定执行。
reason.en: Each stage costs two Fallen Frost. No independently verified early-switch animation cue is claimed in this guide.

fallback.zh: 不足6时用实际可用EX、终结技或队伍紊乱补足；不要把一二蓄当三蓄。
fallback.en: Below six, use actually available EX, Ultimate or squad Disorder; one or two stages are not a three-stage slash.

label.zh: 嘉音持续驻唱 · 咏叹华彩未退出
label.en: Astra keeps singing · while Idyllic Cadenza remains active

title.zh: 雅Q已就绪时兑现，并观察回点
title.en: Use Miyabi’s ready Ultimate and check the refill

trigger.zh: 雅自己的喧响就绪、目标可命中且增益有效。
trigger.en: Miyabi’s own Ultimate is ready, with a hittable target and active buffs.

complete.zh: 发动得到3落霜，确认延迟终结一击命中，再按当前点数继续。
complete.en: Activation gives three Fallen Frost. Confirm the delayed finishing hit, then continue using the current total.

reason.zh: 资源和伤害结算分别判断；不会仅凭本招就宣布下一次三蓄已备好。
reason.en: Resource gain and damage are checked separately; this move alone does not guarantee another three-stage slash.

fallback.zh: 未就绪就回常态；避免满落霜时无目的溢出。
fallback.en: Return to the regular loop if unavailable; avoid unnecessary overflow at full Fallen Frost.

label.zh: 嘉音持续驻唱 · 咏叹华彩未退出
label.en: Astra keeps singing · while Idyllic Cadenza remains active

prep.zh: 目标实际可输出；三蓄仍检查六点，嘉音Q不等于敌人失衡。
prep.en: The target must actually be vulnerable. Check six points for the slash; Astra’s Ultimate does not imply enemy Stun.

text.zh: 雅2影开场六落霜可先三蓄；后续仍看实际回点，不每轮重发。
text.en: Miyabi M2 can spend the opening six Fallen Frost immediately; later loops still use actual gains.

text.zh: 柳2影额外突刺消耗能量；结束后的下落命中异常目标才触发极性，不每刺一次。
text.en: Yanagi M2 extra thrusts spend energy; Polarity occurs on the later downward hit against an Anomalous target, not on each thrust.

text.zh: 嘉音4影在连携或Q后的限定时段可无和弦提示快支；不等于无能量也能取得核心加攻。
text.en: Astra M4 can prompt assists without Chords for its limited post-Chain/Ultimate window; this does not grant the energy-consuming core ATK buff without energy.

text.zh: 嘉音专武支援回能有间隔，全队增伤需实际消耗至少25能量；不把装备专武当作永远满两层。
text.en: Astra’s signature assist energy has a cooldown, and its team DMG buff needs an actual spend of at least 25 energy; equipping it does not guarantee two permanent stacks.

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.嘉音开启驻唱，按提示接雅: 点特殊技驻唱，命中后看雅的提示
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.雅快支入场，核对加攻: 看到雅的快支提示再入场
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.柳按真实快支入场: 看到柳的快支提示再入场
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.异常目标上长按EX，确认极性紊乱: 目标已有异常时长按强化特殊技
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.柳衔接快速流转，再按落霜切雅: 普攻后三段接特殊技，再接普攻
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.嘉音Q就绪时，把后两次快支转为连携: 嘉音终结技就绪时开，接实际提示选雅
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.雅Q已就绪时兑现，并观察回点: 雅的终结技就绪时使用

ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.按嘉音触发的雅快支提示。: 看到指向雅的快速支援提示时按对应支援键。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.以普攻后三段积累烈霜；看实际异常与落霜。: 点按普攻，打到能积蓄烈霜的后三段；看目标异常状态及雅的落霜数量。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.终结技，命中后按实际连携提示选择雅。: 嘉音的终结技就绪时按终结技，命中后再在实际出现的连携提示里选雅。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.终结技：名残雪。: 雅的终结技就绪且窗口合适时，按终结技。

ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1091: 用普攻积蓄烈霜；能量够时点按强化特殊技。满6点落霜才长按普攻蓄满三段。
ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1221: 点普攻打到第3、4或5段，再点特殊技切换架势；目标已有异常且能量够，才能长按强化特殊技打极性紊乱。

ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.131100005: 点按特殊技，等攻击命中并进入驻唱
ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.131100012: 喧响到「极」且终结技就绪时点按终结技，等命中

109100001: 为了积烈霜，点普攻打到第三至第五段；这是本步积蓄路线，不是发动强化特殊技的门槛。
Build Frost Anomaly with Basic hits 3–5; this is a buildup route, not an EX prerequisite.
109100002: 6落霜时长按普攻到第三阶段再释放；这是蓄力等级，不是点三下普攻。
At six Fallen Frost, hold Basic to charge level 3 and release; it is not three taps.
122100002: 切架势的这条普通特殊技路线：在普攻第三、四或五段后点特殊技；切完再点普攻直达新架势第三段。不是强化特殊技的必备前置。
For this normal Special stance change, tap Special after Basic hit 3, 4 or 5. Tap Basic after the switch to start at hit 3 in the new stance; this is not required before EX.
122100008: 本步终结技前不用普攻；落雷后想续段，可点普攻接第三段。
No Basic before the Ultimate. After the lightning strike, optionally link into Basic hit 3.
122100010: 先响应快速支援；要续普攻可在入场后直接接第三段，不必先普攻。
Respond to Quick Assist first; optionally link into Basic hit 3 on entry without an earlier Basic string.

1221: 要按普通特殊技切架势，才在普攻第三、四或五段衔接。要打极性紊乱则是目标已有异常、有能量时长按强化特殊技，不用先打普攻。
Use Basic hit 3, 4 or 5 for the normal Special stance link. For Polarity Disorder, hold EX with Energy on an afflicted target; no Basic opener.
